en.answer:
If a card is excavated by this effect, the excavated card is verified by both players.

(The opponent can also verify the card)
en.question: For the effect of <<11682>> that excavates a card, can the opponent also verify that card?
en.title: For the effect of <<11682>> that excavates a card, can the opponent also verify that card?

ja.answer:
「<<11682>>」の効果で、『自分のデッキの一番上のカードをめくり』の処理を行う場合、めくったカードの内容はお互いのプレイヤーが確認する事になります。
（相手プレイヤーもカードの内容を確認する事ができます。）
